checks.message: Frame is 1080×1920; the project format is 1080×1920.

checks.limits: Downscaled near-black full-frame check; does not assess exposure, intent or general visual quality.

vvv.limits: Motion is measured as frame-to-frame change; grain or noise overlays can hide a frozen subject.
review: The first three seconds give a reason to keep watching.
Each beat has one main thing to read, and text stays on screen long enough to read it.
Text is legible at phone size for the chosen format.
Names, dates and captions match the photos and the supplied facts.
The soundtrack suits the story, and its entry, exit and level work when listened to.

visualReview.method: 17 actual 1080p output frames at 0.5–18.3s, including cut boundaries; not continuous playback or listening acceptance.
visualReview.correction: End-shot protection expanded to the raised hand/cup area; automatic planning hides the unsafe end title.
visualReview.browser: Verified existing segment list, role/time/group controls and protection/crop guides; captured annotation-interface.png. Drag/save interaction not exercised in browser; API save validated separately.
